title: Mail delivery retries
request: Why does a retry send the same receipt twice?
reply: The worker sends the receipt before saving its success. Reuse the delivery token as the idempotency key so that a retry cannot send a duplicate.

title: Sampling the sensors
request: What is making telemetry uploads so large?
reply: The new probes send every reading separately. Batch sixty readings into one upload to reduce the per-request overhead.

title: Publisher recovery
request: Can the reader recover from an interrupted file replacement?
reply: Write the next catalog to a temporary file and atomically rename it. Readers then see either the old catalog or the complete replacement.

title: Kiosk timekeeping
request: How can a lobby kiosk keep time when the network goes away?
reply: Use the battery-backed clock during the outage. When connectivity returns, compare the time with the server before accepting appointments.
